# User Story **As a Developer, I want to improve the chunking strategy to better handle large code files with multiple classes so that downstream processing and analysis are more efficient and reliable.** ## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Ensure the chunking strategy segments based on class structures
- [ ] Handle edge cases where class boundaries are unclear
- [ ] Benchmark performance improvements for large file processing ---
